subject: Warm transfer: Argo Health - implementation ownership & launch milestones
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>; Emma Liu <emma@argohealth.com>, Paul Smith <paul.smith@argohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Warm transfer: Argo Health - implementation ownership & launch milestones

Hi team / Emma & Paul —

Thanks again for a great pilot conversation last week. Argo has signed and legal returned the redlines; finance has confirmed initial invoice schedule. High-level ask: I want us to do a tight sales->CS handoff so we can hit Argo's requested launch window (beta data ingest by 2027-04-15, company-wide rollout by 2027-06-01).

What's included in this thread:
- Attach: ArgoHealth_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (mutual action plan, milestones, owners)
- Attach: Argo_ProdScope.xlsx (technical scope summary from the demo)
- Draft SOW in Drive link below

Immediate needs from CS/implementation:
1) Confirm primary CS owner and backup (we need replicated coverage for support hours).
2) Quick intake call with Argo's engineering lead (Paul) — 60 min technical review to validate data formats and sandbox access.
3) Confirm timeline risk items (data availability, API keys, security attestation) and any prelaunch support blocks.

Vanessa — can you own the handoff and be primary for this account? Ben — please be backup and lead technical intake with Paul if Vanessa needs help. Tessa — FYI on staffing cadence for Apr/May ramp.

Emma / Paul, copying you so we have continuity. The mutual action plan in the attachment has proposed owner assignments; happy to adjust in this thread. Proposed kickoff: Tue 2027-02-22 11:00 PT for a 30-min alignment call (internal only) and follow-on 60-min technical deep-dive with Paul on 2027-02-24. Does that work?

Thanks — excited to get this into your hands.

Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ArgoHealth_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (PDF), Argo_ProdScope.xlsx (Excel), SOW-Draft-Argo-4821.docx (Word)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma@argohealth.com>, Paul Smith <paul.smith@argohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Warm transfer: Argo Health - implementation ownership & launch milestones

Thanks Jonas — happy to take primary.

Quick internal notes and asks before the intake:
- Primary owner: Vanessa Ortiz (onboarding & adoption). Backup: Ben Carter (technical & escalation).
- I'll lead PM for the kickoff and own the 30/60-day milestone list.
- Pre-kickoff asks for Argo: API access to their staging S3 bucket, a sanitized sample dataset (<= 50k rows), and whitelist IPs for sandbox. Emma / Paul — can you confirm those items are listed as available by 2027-03-01?

Preliminary risk register (short):
- Security questionnaire: Argo requested SOC 2 in vendor pack — we have standard answers but they want the auditor contact. (Action: Legal to share attestation doc; Jonas flagged legal redlines are accepted.)
- Data shape variance: demo used normalized CSVs; production is nested JSON — Ben, we'll need to validate mapping rules.
- Integrations: Argo uses a custom ETL; we may need a small connector (1-2 sprint effort) if they can't provide normalized exports.

Ben — can you schedule the 60-min technical deep-dive with Paul for 02/24? Prefer 10:00-11:30 PT window. I'll put together the onboarding checklist and milestone owners before our internal 11:00 PT sync tomorrow.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa — I'm on board to be backup and to lead technical intake.

Paul — quick intake checklist for the 60-min deep-dive:
- We need a sample export (sanitized) and a short readme describing cadence and schema
- Sandbox credentials: role-based service account + temporary key (we'll walk through best practices)
- Expected max token lengths for documents (helps with model selection/tuning)
- Any regulatory constraints on logging or embedding retention (PII redaction requirements)

I've tentatively booked Wed 2027-02-24 10:30-11:30 PT for the technical deep-dive (invites sent). If that conflicts, I'll move.

Deliverables Ben will own:
- Technical intake doc (shared drive) by 2027-02-25
- Simple transform scripts for mapping nested JSON to normalized rows (if required) — prototype by 2027-03-08
- Integration impact estimate and sprint count by 2027-03-11

Risk note: If Argo cannot provide sample data by 03-01 we should re-evaluate the 04-15 beta target — flagging for PM/leadership.

Ben Carter
Manager, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks all. Short follow-ups and next steps so this thread is the single source of truth for owners:

- Confirmed owners: Vanessa (primary CS), Ben (technical backup/SE). Tessa — please add staffing window for Apr-May to the staffing roster and flag any conflicts by EOD 2027-02-25.
- Argo asks: Emma confirmed staging S3 and sanitized sample will be ready by 2027-03-01 (per separate note). Paul, thank you — we'll use that as our blocker gating beta.
- Deliverable timeline (agreeing to MAP):
  * 2027-02-24: technical deep-dive (Ben + Paul) — invite contains agenda
  * 2027-02-25: technical intake doc (Ben) + onboarding checklist draft (Vanessa)
  * 2027-03-08: transform prototype if needed (Ben)
  * 2027-03-15: sandbox ingest validation complete (CS + SE)
  * 2027-04-15: beta ingest window (target)

Resources and links: HubSpot deal and shared Drive above. I'm also dropping a short note for Legal to attach SOC 2 attestation to the Drive folder; Ben/Vanessa — if a CISO call is required, let's schedule in the week of 2027-03-07.

Emma / Paul — thanks again for the speedy turnaround. Vanessa will reach out with calendar invites and the onboarding checklist shortly. If anything changes on your side (data availability or stakeholder bandwidth) please loop us in here.

Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
